description: The Geospatial Data Tools page of the National Laboratory of the Rockies, the former National Renewable Energy Laboratory, is a single index of the laboratory's data sets and tools for siting and planning energy supply. It groups biomass atlases, the Geothermal Prospector, hydrogen data such as the HyDRA viewer and a 2009 county-level hydrogen resource shapefile of 51 MB, the Marine Energy Atlas for US coasts, solar tools including the National Solar Radiation Database, PVWatts and solar supply curves, wind tools including the WIND Toolkit with more than 126,000 US sites and wind supply curves, and cross-cutting resources: the RE Atlas, the reV model, energy supply curves and the State and Local Planning for Energy tool. Coverage is the United States, with international solar radiation data sets. The page was last updated on 12 May 2026. Format and access: web pages that link to viewers, APIs, models and downloadable GIS layers; the individual licences were not read. Caveats: an index, not the data itself, and NREL links may redirect after the rename. It maps where resources and infrastructure interact for capacity planning and optimisation studies. Related catalogue records are the National Solar Radiation Database and the Global Solar Atlas.
